# Gemini Web MCP

> Python MCP stdio gateway for Gemini Web chat, background tasks, Deep Research, media generation, and NotebookLM.

- [Source](https://github.com/Luckycat133/gemini-web-mcp) · [Verified v0.24.2 release](https://github.com/Luckycat133/gemini-web-mcp/releases/tag/v0.24.2)
- Runtime: Python 3.11 or later; MCP Python SDK v2 (`mcp>=2,<3`, `mcp-types>=2,<3`).
- Start MCP clients with the installed `gemini-web-mcp` command and no arguments over stdio. Use `gemini-web-cli --help` for separate, explicitly requested account management.
- The public MCP surface contains exactly eight tools: `ask-gemini`, `generate-image`, `generate-video`, `generate-music`, `run-research`, `run-task`, `get-operation`, and `check-quota`.
- Read the live MCP `tools/list` schemas. Reuse operation handles with `get-operation` rather than launching generation again. Never send cookie values in prompts, shared client config, or migration reports.
- [Full guide](llms-full.txt) · [Offline verification and migration](docs/agent-verification.md)
